prompts.name: pencil
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: One production toolbar icon for the SimplePaint drawing application, a square PNG image intended to display at only 24 x 24 logical points.
Style: crisp, simple flat desktop utility icon, dark charcoal (#263238) consistent bold outlines with rounded joins, minimal color accents, no texture, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D.
Background: solid pure white (#FFFFFF), fully opaque, edge to edge. No transparency.
Composition: a single centered glyph, complete silhouette, generous but even padding of about 15% on all sides. Square 1024 x 1024 canvas. Strong readable silhouette after reduction to 24 pixels. Keep details large and simple.
Constraints: exactly one icon, no caption, no lettering, no watermark, no surrounding button frame, no multiple variants, no grid.
Subject: a classic yellow ochre wooden pencil with dark graphite tip, drawn diagonally from bottom left tip to top right eraser end. Simple flat silhouette with charcoal outline. Communicates freehand drawing. No scribble, no paper.
